title: Block: Gallery rail

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Optional section heading (h2) above the photos; it also names the photo row for screen readers (without it the row is called «Bildergalerie»).

fields.label: Text
fields.name: text
fields.instructions: Optional text between the heading and the photos, e.g. the description of a project.

fields.label: Images
fields.name: images
fields.instructions: Photos in this order. They form one row that scrolls sideways (buttons ‹ ›, swipe, arrow keys); no autoplay.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional line under the photo (the alt text comes from the media library).

fields.label: Background
fields.name: background
fields.instructions: Section background: alternate with the neighbouring sections; yellow only for short sections, at most one per screen (DESIGN.md, Sections).

description: Fields for the gallery rail block (blocks/lists/gallery-rail.php).
